title: Practice: How prefixes work: при- and у-

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: «при-»: принести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Ideas occur to me on the spur of the moment.
exercises.why: «при-»: приходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Thank you for coming to my rescue.
exercises.why: «при-»: прийти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«у-»: уйти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
exercises.why: «при-»: привести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Ancient Carthaginians engaged in child sacrifice.
exercises.why: «при-»: приносить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The dog came running to us.
exercises.why: «при-»: прибежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«при-»: привозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: When will Yuko come to Denver?
exercises.why: «при-»: приехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Drop everything and get over here.
exercises.why: «при-»: приезжать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The boy ran away without looking back.
exercises.why: «у-»: убежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: She brought a can of hojicha from Japan.
exercises.why: «при-»: привезти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He was taken to the hospital.
exercises.why: «у-»: увезти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Как только я отучусь, я ___ (уезжать) из этой страны.
exercises.prompt: I'll leave this country as soon as I graduate.
exercises.why: «у-»: уезжать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
